full_text:
Wild nights - Wild nights!
Were I with thee.
Wild nights should be.
Our luxury!
Futile - the winds.
To a Heart in port.
Done with the Compass.
Done with the Chart!
image_prompts: A stormy night with towering trees swaying violently under a moonlit sky, capturing the chaos of 'Wild nights'.
A lone figure under a tree, reaching toward another in the distance, emphasizing yearning and intimacy.
A serene yet untamed forest at night, with glowing fireflies and a sense of wild beauty.
A cozy cabin surrounded by wilderness, with warm golden light spilling out to symbolize 'Our luxury'.
A person struggling against a fierce wind, their face showing despair as the storm rages.
A heart-shaped ship anchored in a calm harbor at dawn, with a lone figure gazing at the horizon.
A sailor at sea with a broken compass, the night sky above reflecting confusion and futility.
An old, unraveled map scattered in the dark, with a single light shining on a heart-shaped mark.
